test_title: PYST 07: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Identify the part containing a grammatical or structural error: The jury was divided in their opinions.
solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. was divided.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the use of **"was"** with the collective noun **"jury."**
 
• When a collective noun like **"jury"** refers to a group acting as individuals, we typically use **"were"** instead of **"was"**.
 
• In this case, **"were"** should be used to indicate that the members of the jury, not the group as a singular entity, are acting separately.

Correct sentence: *"The jury were divided in their opinions."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "No error"** is incorrect because "was" should be replaced with "were" for subject-verb agreement with the collective noun "jury" when considered as individuals.
 
• **Option 2: "The jury"** is correct, as "the jury" is the subject of the sentence, but it doesn't address the verb error.
 
• **Option 3: "was divided"** is incorrect because the verb "was" should be replaced with "were" when referring to a collective noun acting as separate individuals.
